promise.headline: Love is a daily practice.
promise.sub: 90 seconds a day to feel more Attractive, Valued, and Wanted.

options.crush: Got a crush I want to be closer to
options.healing: Healing / Becoming magnetic for next love

aq-1.prompt: When they don't text back for hours, you...

options.3: Want closeness but fear bothering them

aq-2.prompt: After a really good date or conversation, you...

options.0: Feel good and look forward to the next one
options.1: Immediately worry it will fade or was too good to be true
options.2: Feel a small urge to pull back and take stock
options.3: Feel happy but brace for it to go wrong somehow

aq-3.prompt: When a conflict comes up, you...

options.0: Address it directly and expect it to get resolved
options.1: Feel panicked and need it resolved right away
options.2: Want to withdraw until things cool down
options.3: Want to fix it but freeze or say nothing

aq-4.prompt: Your partner wants a weekend to themselves. You...

options.0: Are fine with it, plan your own time
options.1: Wonder if something is wrong between you
options.2: Feel relieved to have the space too
options.3: Want to say it is fine but feel unsettled

aq-5.prompt: Being told "I need you" by a partner makes you feel...

options.1: Relieved — this is what you wanted to hear
options.3: Warm but also scared of letting them down

aq-6.prompt: When you picture your ideal amount of closeness, it is...

options.0: Close but with room for independence, and that feels easy
options.1: As close as possible, as often as possible
options.2: Independent first, closeness on your own terms
options.3: You want it deeply but it also scares you

loveLanguagePairs.prompt: Which would make you feel MORE loved after a hard day?

ll-1.0: I handled that errand for you
ll-1.1: You mean so much to me, I'm proud of you

ll-2.0: A small gift that shows they were thinking of you
ll-2.1: Twenty minutes of their full, undistracted attention

ll-3.0: A long hug, no words needed
ll-3.1: A text list of things they appreciate about you

ll-4.0: They quietly took something off your plate
ll-4.1: They sat with you while you decompressed, no phones

payoff.summary: Got it. You're {{attachmentPhrase}}, and you feel most loved through {{receivesVia}}, but you SHOW love through {{givesVia}}. That's why you feel unseen sometimes. Here's your first micro-adjustment…
payoff.firstWinFallback: I love how you think out loud when you're solving something - you don't hide the messy part.

ritualTime.headline: When should we do your 90-sec check-in?

checkin.headline: 90-sec Micro-Attunement
checkin.sub: How are things feeling right now?
checkin.thanksLogged: Thanks — logged to help tailor future actions.

action.consistencyReassurance: Morning voice note, same time daily: 'Thinking of you before your meeting'
action.lowPressureSpace: No-reply-needed check-in: 'Saw this meme and thought of you, no need to reply'
action.safeVulnerability: Share one small worry first, then appreciation. Shows it's safe to be vulnerable.
action.directRepair: Ask directly: 'I felt a bit distant yesterday, can we reset tonight?'
action.recallDetailWithEntry: Last time they mentioned "{{detail}}". Ask about it today.
action.recallDetailGeneric: Ask an open question about something they care about, and really listen for a detail to remember.
action.specificDesireWithEntry: They said "{{desire}}" makes them feel wanted. Do that today.
action.specificDesireGeneric: Do one small, specific thing that shows you chose them on purpose today.

bids.headline: Bid Tracker
bids.sub: Log a small moment, then say how it landed.
bids.placeholder: e.g. Partner made a joke while I was on my phone
bids.noBidsYet: No bids logged yet this week.
bids.repairQuest: Try a Curiosity Card + Appreciation quest today to help turn this around.

curiosity.headline: Today's Curiosity Card
curiosity.completedAllForStage: You've completed every card for this stage. More unlock as your ritual continues.

memoryVault.headline: Memory Vault
memoryVault.notConfigured: Needs Firebase configured to store anything real — see docs/06-firebase-provisioning.md.
memoryVault.sub: Small, specific things they've mentioned — used to help you recall them later.
memoryVault.placeholder: e.g. Mentioned wanting to try that new ramen place

desireInventory.headline: Desire Inventory
desireInventory.notConfigured: Needs Firebase configured to store anything real — see docs/06-firebase-provisioning.md.
desireInventory.sub: Specific things that make you feel wanted, ranked by how much they matter.

settings.headline: Settings
settings.privacyCopy: This is your private sanctuary. No data is ever sold. Partner mode requires explicit double opt-in. You can delete your Memory Vault anytime.

partner.headline: Partner Mode
partner.sub: Both people opt in explicitly — nothing links automatically.
partner.shareHint: Share this with your partner so they can enter it below.
partner.ownCodeError: That's your own code — ask your partner for theirs.
partner.bothOptedIn: You're both in — just finishing the connection. Check back soon.
partner.pending: Pending — waiting for your partner to enter your code too.

retention.bidResponse: Your Bid Response is at {{pct}}% this week — that's Secure Zone. One more check-in locks it in.

recalibration.message: We learned you feel more loved by {{language}} than you thought. Adjusting your plan.
